('Maria Santos', '11976543210', 'maria.santos@email.com', 'whatsapp', NOW()),
('Pedro Oliveira', '11965432109', 'pedro.oliveira@email.com', 'instagram', NOW()),
('Ana Costa', '11954321098', 'ana.costa@email.com', 'whatsapp', NOW()),
('Carlos Ferreira', '11943210987', 'carlos.ferreira@email.com', 'instagram', NOW());

-- Inserir conversas (usando IDs dos últimos 5 clientes)
INSERT INTO conversations (customer_id, channel, status, opened_at, created_at) 
SELECT id, channel, 'waiting', DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL FLOOR(1 + RAND() * 5) HOUR), NOW()
FROM customers ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 3;

INSERT INTO conversations (customer_id, channel, status, opened_at, assigned_at, assigned_to, created_at)
SELECT id, channel, 'assigned', DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL FLOOR(6 + RAND() * 5) HOUR), DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL FLOOR(5 + RAND() * 3) HOUR), 1, NOW()
FROM customers ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 2 OFFSET 3;

-- Inserir mensagens (usando IDs das últimas conversas)
INSERT INTO conversation_messages (conversation_id, sender_id, sender_type, content, sent_at, created_at)
SELECT c.id, c.customer_id, 'customer', 'Olá! Gostaria de tirar uma dúvida sobre medicamentos.', c.opened_at, NOW()
FROM conversations c ORDER BY c.id DESC LIMIT 5;
